name: Ganga Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Ganga Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is actively involved in the production and trade of pharmaceutical products and related goods. The company primarily concentrates on the formulation, marketing, and supply of Ayurvedic medicines in bulk quantities. Notable products in its portfolio include Ampachan Vati, Khadira Vati, and Nirmalaya Churna. The firm offers a range of Ayurvedic solutions designed to address health issues such as acidity, dandruff, oxidative stress, constipation, oral hygiene, diarrhea, ear ailments, women's health, and joint discomfort. Brijmohan C. Sharma founded the organization in 1974, and its main corporate office is located in Mumbai, India.
